summary: Kaylee Messerly, 36, and her two young daughters (3-year-old and 18-month-old) stranded after their car stuck in snow and mud on a remote service road off County Road 54; deputies found the unoccupied vehicle Thursday morning and MCSO, Moffat County SAR, and a Mountain Air Spray aircraft launched a formal search. Messerly and the 3-year-old were found alive about a mile from the vehicle with severe environmental-exposure injuries; the 18-month-old was found deceased.
responding_agency: Moffat County Sheriff's Office, Moffat County Search and Rescue, Mountain Air Spray
notes: Survivors had been exposed two nights in frigid cold per CBS Denver follow-up; sources differ on road number (Townsquare says CR 53, sheriff release/CBS say CR 54). Townsquare article says incident concluded Thursday, matching 2021-03-11.
